notes:
Lead: early-stage SMB (customer-support SaaS). Self-serve signups; wants quick POC on hosted API.

Customer priorities: cost predictability during onboarding spikes, keep live chat responsive during promos, simple retry semantics for front-end clients.

Key technical constraints / ask:
- Mostly public cloud (GCP), no VPC/private deployment needed for now.
- Frontend opens WS connections and issues concurrent generation calls for live chat widgets; typical concurrency target ~10-20 concurrent requests per org, peaks up to 150 during marketing pushes.
- Wants clear guidance on: token quotas vs concurrency limits, per-minute vs per-second quotas, and recommended client-side retry-with-jitter to avoid thundering herd.
- Concerned about 429s: "We can't have the chat die during a campaign — need graceful degradation (stream fallback to canned responses)." — CTO Laura Kim.
- Interested in automatic burst handling: temporary soft-burst allowance for first 24h after signup and automated email when quotas hit 80%.
- Cost sensitivity: SMB; prefers hosted API metered billing but wants tooling to set hard caps per workspace.
use_case_summary: Implement hosted generation for live chat + agent assist. Primary workload: low-latency chat with intermittent heavy spikes (marketing campaigns). Secondary: nightly summarization/cleanup jobs. Requires predictable per-request latency (<300ms p50 for short replies) and safe throttling behavior for spikes.
technical_requirements:
- Concurrency target: 10-20 steady, burst to 100-150 for short windows.
- Soft quota notifications + hard caps by API key/workspace.
- Prefer 429s delivered with Retry-After header and guidance for exponential backoff + jitter.
- Need sample client retry library or code snippets for web widgets.
- Wants opt-in temporary burst increase for onboarding days.
- Audit logs and basic SOC2-era controls required.
sales_play_notes:
SMB inbound, high chance to self-serve but close with low-touch. Offer 14-day POC credits and a 'burst guard' starter config (recommended quotas + client retry snippets). Package: hosted_api, suggest Optimize later once usage stabilizes.
Action: provision test API keys, schedule 11/22 spike test, provide concise one-page '429 handling' playbook for devs.
quote_from_customer: "If the chat blanks during a promo, our churn will spike. We need graceful degradation, not hard 500s. Give us simple knobs and clear retry rules." — Laura Kim, CTO
next_actions_for_ae: 1) Send API keys + prod-like traffic script. 2) Share '429/playbook' and client retry snippets. 3) Coordinate spike window w/ engineering (aim 2024-11-22). 4) Follow up after POC with usage report and suggested quotas.
internal_risks:
- May outgrow SMB plan quickly if successful (budget adjustments).
- Needs faster turnaround on support for throttle exceptions.
- Could evaluate direct cloud providers if self-serve fails to meet burst needs.
recommended_poc_metrics:
- 429 rate during spike (target <1%).
- Mean response latency at p50/p95 during spike.
- Number of concurrent connections sustained without 429.
- Cost per 1k tokens under burst vs baseline.
